SELECT b.PRJ_POST_NO, b.PRJ_NO, b.USER_ID, b.TITLE, b.CREATE_DATE, b.CONTENT, b.DELETE_DATE, mem.USER_NAME, mem.USER_POSITION, mem.AUTHORITY_CODE, mem.DELETE_DATE AS memDeleteDate, c.COMMENT_NO, c.COMMENT_CONTENT, c.CREATE_DATE AS commentCreateDate, c.DELETE_DATE AS commentDeleteDate, c.USER_ID AS commentUserId FROM PRJ_BBS b LEFT JOIN PRJ_MEM mem ON b.PRJ_NO = mem.PRJ_NO AND b.USER_ID = mem.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PRJ_BBS_COMMENT c ON b.PRJ_POST_NO = c.PRJ_POST_NO WHERE b.PRJ_POST_NO = #{prjPostNo} ORDER BY b.CREATE_DATE DESC, c.CREATE_DATE ASC
